description: This file defines a database migration class for the Android application, specifically migrating database schema from version 22 to 23. It adds a new 'displayName' column to the 'Account' table and sanitizes stored API version data within account records. The code utilizes Android's Room persistence library and other Android-specific components.

classes.name: Migration_22_23
classes.description: Represents a database migration from version 22 to 23, adding displayName column and sanitizing API version data.

methods.name: Migration_22_23
methods.description: Constructor initializing migration from schema version 22 to 23.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes the migration steps, including adding displayName column and sanitizing accounts.

methods.name: addDisplayNameToAccounts
methods.description: Adds the displayName column to the Account table.

methods.name: sanitizeAccounts
methods.description: Reads account data, sanitizes API version information, and updates records accordingly.

methods.name: sanitizeApiVersion
methods.description: Parses and sanitizes the JSON string representing API versions, filtering out invalid or zero versions.
